summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI, then address a series of CI/deployment issues (Grafana provisioning, desktop signing, writable shares test failures) and perform maintenance cleanup (codebase docs, worktrees, milestone artifacts).
summary.outcome: Fixed the vault recovery E2E via a protobuf field number bug (field 2 → field 1) and resolution order swap; fixed writable shares E2E via an IPNS key ID mismatch in standalone file shares; wired Tauri signing keys into the staging workflow and removed the redundant build-desktop.yml; updated all 7 codebase analysis docs to reflect the multi-package/crate architecture.

repo: IPNS records encode the value (CID path) at protobuf field 1, not field 2 — field 2 is signatureV1. The extractCidFromIpnsRecord function in recovery.html had this wrong.

The resolveIpns function tried the Kubo IPFS gateway HEAD first (15s timeout) before delegated routing — in CI, Kubo can't resolve mock-ipns-routing names so this wasted 15s per call. Delegated routing should always be tried first.

Standalone file shares create a synthetic FilePointer with id=shareId, but share_keys stores the file-ipns key with itemId=fileId (the real file UUID). These IDs don't match, causing getFileIpnsKeyFn to return null.

The ThrottlerModule in app.module.ts uses hardcoded limits regardless of NODE_ENV — the full web-e2e suite was hitting 429s locally because of this. ThrottlerModule needs forRootAsync with env-based limits for test environments.
tauri-apps/tauri-action@v1 does not exist — only @v0 (current v0.6.2). The build-desktop.yml was referencing a non-existent major version causing startup_failure on every release event.

The staging deploy workflow had prerelease: true on desktop builds and was missing includeUpdaterJson: true — this meant the Tauri auto-updater's /releases/latest/download/latest.json endpoint could never resolve staging builds.
The Grafana dashboard provisioning uses a Grafana service account token (not the Loki/Prometheus data source keys). The GRAFANA_API_KEY secret stores this token and it had expired.

The BypassableThrottlerGuard reads X-Throttle-Bypass header from requests, but browser-based E2E tests can't inject headers — making the NODE_ENV=test path the only reliable way to relax throttling for full suite runs.

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord checked fieldNumber === 2 (signatureV1) instead of fieldNumber === 1 (value). Root cause of all IPNS resolution failures in recovery flow.

resolveIpns tried IPFS gateway HEAD first. After fix: delegated routing tried first, gateway as fallback. Also fixed double-consume bug where resp.json() was called then resp.arrayBuffer() on the same response.

Standalone file shares build a fake FilePointer with id: shareItem.share.shareId but the file-ipns key was stored with itemId = actual file UUID. Fallback added: if itemId match fails and shareItem.share.itemType === 'file', use first file-ipns key.
ThrottlerModule converted to forRootAsync to read NODE_ENV — when NODE_ENV=test, limits are 200/sec and 2000/min instead of 10/sec and 100/min.
All 3 tauri-action invocations (macOS/Windows/Linux) now include TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY + TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD env vars, includeUpdaterJson: true, and prerelease: false.

workflow: Running the full web-e2e suite locally requires the API to be started with NODE_ENV=test explicitly — dotenv does not override a process env var that is already set, so this must precede the npm start command.

When parallel Playwright test suites share the same API and database, account creation steps interfere with each other causing cascading 429s and login failures — suites should not be run in parallel locally.

CI uses NODE_ENV=test automatically, making its test results more reliable than naive local runs. Local full-suite runs need to match CI's environment config exactly before being considered authoritative.
The /gsd:progress workflow reliably identifies active debug sessions and can be used to triage stale ones — debug sessions tied to deleted worktrees should be resolved immediately.
Subagent parallelism (3 mapper agents in parallel) significantly speeds up broad codebase analysis tasks like updating all documentation files simultaneously.

friction: Round-tripping to CI to get writable shares E2E passing — multiple pushes before the root cause (IPNS key ID mismatch) was found. User explicitly asked to stop this pattern and run full suite locally first.
NODE_ENV=test throttle issue was discovered late — the full local suite was producing 429 failures that masked real test results for most of the session.
1Password SSH agent not accessible from subprocess contexts, causing commit signing failures that required manual git commands.
Stale worktrees left over from previous phases needed cleanup before work could continue cleanly.
Docker Hub authentication errors on GitHub Actions caused transient CI failures unrelated to code changes (required re-running jobs).
Two parallel background test runs interfering with each other mid-session, producing confusing failure signals.
The debug session for vault-migration-iife-silent-failure was tied to a worktree that no longer existed, making it impossible to continue — earlier cleanup of stale sessions would have been better.
open_items: docs/milestone-v1.1-completion branch has 2 commits (debug session resolution + codebase docs rewrite) but has not been PRed or merged yet.
The /gsd:complete-milestone command has not been run — milestone v1.1 is fully executed but not archived. 6 pending todos and planning artifacts need archiving.

The 3 locally-failing web-e2e tests (recycle-bin TC01, mfa-flows TC-MFA-01, full-workflow 6.5.4) were identified as environment-specific but not investigated — may indicate real issues with local dev setup or be genuine flaky tests.

The Tauri updater endpoint in tauri.conf.json points to /releases/latest/download/latest.json — now that prerelease: false is set, this should work, but needs verification on the next staging release cut.
CLAUDE.md additions recommended by the /insights report (branch checking before commits, PR review verification, project-local file editing) have not been implemented.
